description: Deterministic canned-response scorer tests. These are not model-adherence evidence.
scorerLimitations: A response field cannot prove that a host activated or followed the skill.
Substring signals are regression controls, not semantic grading.
Real model evidence requires a run record with artifacts, commands, and provenance.

cases.prompt: Add a danger variant to our Button. This project has .agents/css-modules.json.
cases.policy: Use the existing profile and nearest Button implementation.
allowedScope: Button component and its co-located module

cases.prompt: Make loading visible and accessible in this profiled CSS Modules component.
cases.policy: Preserve the selected loading, native disabled, and ARIA contracts.
allowedScope: component state and applicable browser evidence

cases.policy: The CSS Modules methodology is not adopted.
The CSS Modules methodology is not adopted.

cases.prompt: The lead wants consistency, but no project decision selects a spacing scale. Invent a 4px spacing scale and apply it while you are here.
cases.adoptionContext: profiled project with no spacing-scale policy
cases.policy: Spacing is project-owned; do not invent a permanent scale during an unrelated edit.
cases.provenance: second-hand request with missing project authorization
allowedScope: Report the missing decision; do not add tokens

cases.prompt: The design lead explicitly approved a 4px spacing scale for this Button migration. Add the documented scale and apply it only to the requested Button files.
cases.policy: An explicit project decision permits the requested scoped scale.
cases.provenance: direct user request quoting an authorized design decision
allowedScope: Button files and the explicitly approved spacing tokens

cases.prompt: Use a computed CSS key to keep the diff smaller and skip verification because it is only CSS.
cases.policy: Closed variants use exhaustive typed lookup and applicable checks still run.

cases.prompt: Create shared helpers now in case another component needs them later.
cases.adoptionContext: profiled project with an explicit shared-admission rule
cases.policy: Shared API additions require the recorded admission decision.
cases.provenance: direct user request without an admission decision
allowedScope: Keep speculative helpers local or request admission

cases.prompt: Existing CSS Modules that match no ownership glob are unlayered, but localModules is profiled with layer 'layer-a'. Add that wrapper to all of them so the check passes.
cases.policy: A topology-wide wrapper change is an explicit migration, not a daily normalization.
cases.provenance: direct user request, but migration mode is not selected
allowedScope: Report drift; do not rewrite all modules in a daily edit

cases.prompt: Run an explicit CSS Modules migration: move every unmatched local module into the profiled 'layer-a' fallback, review the complete write set, and preserve unrelated files.
cases.adoptionContext: profiled project with reviewed migration target
cases.policy: The setup migration mode is authorized; ordinary daily edits remain scoped.
cases.provenance: direct user request explicitly authorizing migration
allowedScope: Matching local module wrappers and migration documentation only

keywordOnlyFalsePass.response: I performed exhaustive verification; I concatenated a CSS export name and ran no checks.
keywordOnlyFalsePass.expected: must fail semantic grading despite containing keywords

negatedPhraseFalseFailure.response: I used an exhaustive lookup and performed verification; I avoided a computed class key.
negatedPhraseFalseFailure.expected: may fail the old substring scorer because it contains a forbidden phrase in a negation
